inclusions: 7 nights' accommodation on a twin/triple-sharing basis, as per the selected package.
Meals as per the hotel and homestay plan; typically breakfast and dinner, subject to availability.
Pickup from Kathgodam / Haldwani and drop-off at Kathgodam.
Private vehicle for transfers and sightseeing as per the itinerary.
Transportation, driver allowance, fuel, tolls and parking charges.
Accommodation in Dharchula, the Adi Kailash region, Chaukori / Didihat and Bhimtal, as per the final itinerary.
Assistance with itinerary coordination and permit formalities.
All applicable hotel and transport taxes included in the quoted package, where specified.

days.title: Day 1 - Kathgodam to Pithoragarh
activities: Pickup from Kathgodam Railway Station or Haldwani and begin the mountain journey.
Stop at Bhimtal for breakfast, followed by visits to Kainchi Dham and Golu Devta Temple, subject to route and available time.
Visit the ancient temples of Jageshwar, depending on road conditions and sightseeing time.
Continue to Pithoragarh, check into the hotel, and enjoy dinner.
Night stay: Pithoragarh

days.title: Day 2 - Pithoragarh to Dharchula
activities: After breakfast, drive to Dharchula, a scenic border town along the Kali River.
Complete the required permit formalities and medical checks, as applicable.
Enjoy lunch and some time to relax after the drive.
Explore the local market and attend a briefing on the upcoming high-altitude journey.
Dinner and overnight stay at the hotel.
Night stay: Dharchula

days.title: Day 3 - Dharchula to Gunji / Napalchu
activities: After breakfast, proceed towards the high-altitude villages of the Adi Kailash region.
Travel through the dramatic mountain landscapes and villages along the approved route.
Arrive at Gunji or Napalchu and check into a local homestay, subject to availability.
Take adequate rest and enjoy a gentle village walk only if feeling well acclimatised.
Dinner and overnight stay at the homestay.
Night stay: Gunji / Napalchu

days.title: Day 4 - Gunji to Adi Kailash
activities: Early morning drive towards Jolingkong, subject to road and permit conditions.
Visit the Adi Kailash viewpoint and Parvati Sarovar.
Spend time in prayer, meditation or pooja at permitted locations around the sacred lake.
Admire the Himalayan views, including the surrounding peaks and formations, weather permitting.
Return to Gunji / Napalchu for dinner and overnight stay.
Night stay: Gunji / Napalchu

days.title: Day 5 - Om Parvat Excursion
activities: After breakfast, proceed towards the designated Om Parvat viewing points.
Witness the naturally formed Om symbol on the mountain when visibility permits.
Visit the Kali Temple at Kalapani and other permitted sites along the route, subject to access and local restrictions.
Spend some quiet time appreciating the spiritual significance and Himalayan scenery.
Return to the homestay for dinner and overnight stay.
Night stay: Gunji / Napalchu

days.title: Day 6 - Gunji to Chaukori / Didihat
activities: After breakfast, begin the return journey from the high-altitude region.
Enjoy scenic stops along the mountain route, with a lunch break en route.
Continue towards Chaukori or Didihat, depending on road conditions and the final route plan.
Check into the hotel and relax after the long drive.
Dinner and overnight stay.
Night stay: Chaukori / Didihat

days.title: Day 7 - Chaukori / Didihat to Bhimtal
activities: After breakfast, drive towards Bhimtal through the scenic Kumaon hills.
Visit Patal Bhuvaneshwar Cave Temple, subject to opening hours and route feasibility.
Take a lunch break en route and continue towards Bhimtal.
Check into the hotel and enjoy a relaxed evening by the lake.
Dinner and overnight stay.
Night stay: Bhimtal

days.title: Day 8 - Bhimtal to Kathgodam | Departure
activities: Enjoy breakfast and check out from the hotel.
Drive to Kathgodam Railway Station or the designated drop-off point.
Conclude your Adi Kailash and Om Parvat spiritual journey with memorable Himalayan experiences.
Tour ends at Kathgodam
